accounts.name: asset_plan
docs: Required iff `vault_config.has_asset_plan` — read to carve specific-SOL
bequests out of the pro-rata residual (pinned by seeds; omitted otherwise).

accounts.name: vault_ata
docs: The vault's canonical associated token account for `mint`. May not exist.

accounts.name: asset_plan
docs: Required iff `vault_config.has_asset_plan` (P1).

accounts.name: owner
docs: Owner signs and receives the AssetPlan rent refund.

instructions.name: close_executed_vault
docs: Permissionless keeper cleanup of an executed vault after the
owner-exclusive window — rents → payer, dust → largest-share beneficiary.

accounts.name: asset_plan
docs: Present iff `vault_config.has_asset_plan`. Closed manually (rent → payer)
so the PDA slot frees for a future re-init on the same wallet.

accounts.name: largest_benef
docs: Required only when SOL dust remains to be swept.

accounts.name: asset_plan
docs: Present iff `vault_config.has_asset_plan`. Closed manually (rent → owner)
so the PDA slot frees for a future re-init on the same wallet.

accounts.name: largest_benef
docs: Required only when SOL dust remains to be swept.

accounts.name: owner
docs: Owner receives the ATA rent on close.

accounts.name: largest_benef_ata
docs: Required only when there is dust to sweep (vault_ata.amount > 0).

accounts.name: token_dist
docs: Must already exist — its presence gates execution order (§2).

accounts.name: beneficiary
docs: `beneficiaries[assignment.beneficiary_index].wallet`.

accounts.name: asset_plan
docs: Required iff `vault_config.has_asset_plan` (P11 — omitted otherwise).

accounts.name: fee_recipient
docs: Recipient of the on-chain vault-creation fee. Pinned to the hardcoded
FEE_WALLET, so a vault cannot be created without paying the fee.

accounts.name: agent
docs: The agent's device-held key (Keystore/expo-secure-store) signs this

accounts.name: owner
docs: Only the owner can revoke; receives rent refund from closed accounts

accounts.name: asset_plan
docs: Present iff `vault_config.has_asset_plan`. Closed manually so its PDA slot
frees for re-initialization on the same wallet.

accounts.name: owner
docs: Only the owner can rotate the agent key.
The OLD agent must NOT be able to rotate itself.

accounts.name: owner
docs: Owner signs — only the vault owner can withdraw deposited tokens

accounts.name: mint
docs: The mint being withdrawn (provides decimals for transfer_checked; its owner
program must be the token program used).

accounts.name: source_token_account
docs: Vault PDA's token account to withdraw FROM — must be owned by the vault PDA
and hold this mint. The vault PDA (vault_config) is the transfer authority.

accounts.name: destination_token_account
docs: Owner's token account to withdraw TO — must match the same mint.

accounts.name: owner
docs: Owner signs — only the vault owner can withdraw deposited SOL

accounts.name: vault_config
docs: The vault PDA holds both config data AND deposited SOL.
Lamports above rent-exemption are available for withdrawal.

fields.name: mint
docs: Mint of the bequeathed asset (SPL/NFT); the zero-pubkey sentinel = a SOL bequest

fields.name: amount
docs: Exact base units to transfer; 1 for an NFT

fields.name: beneficiary_index
docs: Index into VaultConfig.beneficiaries

fields.name: is_nft
docs: Whether this assignment is a whole NFT (decimals 0, supply 1).
NFT shape is validated client-side (B4) — this flag enforces the
"at most one assignment per NFT mint" rule on-chain.

types.name: AssetPlan
docs: One per vault, fixed-size. Owner-defined specific bequests: SOL (via the
zero-pubkey sentinel mint), SPL tokens, and NFTs. Created by `set_asset_plan`
(strict `init` at full size), edited by `update_asset_plan` (owner overwrite).
Lives on the heap, not the stack.

fields.name: vault
docs: Associated vault config

fields.name: assignments
docs: Specific-bequest assignments (fixed cap MAX_ASSIGNMENTS)

fields.name: paid_mask
docs: Bit j set when assignment j has been executed

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump seed

fields.name: wallet
docs: Wallet address to receive assets

fields.name: share_bps
docs: Percentage share (basis points, 10000 = 100%)

types.name: ExecutionLog
docs: Created by `begin_execution`. Its mere existence == "execution has begun"
(and proves grace was elapsed at that point — downstream permissionless
instructions gate on this account existing rather than re-checking grace).

fields.name: vault
docs: Associated vault config

fields.name: sol_snapshot
docs: Lamports residual for the pro-rata split = (vault balance − rent) − Σ
specific-SOL bequests, frozen at begin_execution. Specific-SOL amounts are
paid separately by execute_specific_sol (carved out here, like token specifics).

fields.name: sol_paid_mask
docs: Bit i set when beneficiary i has been paid their SOL share.

fields.name: started_at
docs: Timestamp execution began

fields.name: completed
docs: Whether finalize_execution has run (sol + asset masks full)

fields.name: transfer_count
docs: Number of SOL transfers executed (incremented only on 0->1 mask transition)

fields.name: total_sol_distributed
docs: Total SOL distributed (in lamports)

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump seed

fields.name: vault
docs: Associated vault config

fields.name: last_heartbeat
docs: Timestamp of last confirmed heartbeat (Unix epoch)

fields.name: last_method
docs: Method used for last heartbeat

fields.name: total_heartbeats
docs: Total heartbeats recorded

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump seed

fields.name: keeper_bounty
docs: Keeper bounty (lamports) reserved for the finalize cranker. 0 = opt out.

types.name: TokenDist
docs: One per (vault, mint). Created by `begin_token_dist`, which freezes the
pro-rata residual (ATA balance minus the sum of specific bequests for this
mint) write-once via strict `init`. Closed by `close_token_dist`.

fields.name: vault
docs: Associated vault config

fields.name: mint
docs: The mint this distribution tracks

fields.name: snapshot
docs: Residual = ata_balance - Σspecific(mint), frozen at begin_token_dist

fields.name: paid_mask
docs: Bit i set when beneficiary i has been paid this token's residual share

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump seed

fields.name: owner
docs: Owner wallet pubkey

fields.name: agent_pubkey
docs: Agent pubkey — device-held key (Android Keystore / expo-secure-store,
biometric-gated). Signs `record_heartbeat` ONLY; never execution.

fields.name: heartbeat_interval
docs: Heartbeat interval in seconds (e.g., 604800 = 7 days)

fields.name: grace_period
docs: Total grace period in seconds from first missed heartbeat to execution

fields.name: beneficiaries
docs: Registered beneficiaries (on-chain whitelist). Index is authoritative —
AssetPlan assignments and paid-masks reference beneficiaries by index.

fields.name: executed
docs: Whether the vault has been executed (prevents double-execution)

fields.name: active
docs: Whether the vault is active (owner can deactivate)

fields.name: created_at
docs: Timestamp when vault was created

fields.name: updated_at
docs: Timestamp when vault config was last updated

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump seed for PDA derivation

fields.name: is_mutable
docs: Whether the vault can be revoked/updated by the owner (false = immutable)

fields.name: has_asset_plan
docs: Whether a canonical AssetPlan PDA exists for this vault. Set true by
`set_asset_plan`; gates whether execution instructions require the plan.

fields.name: open_token_dists
docs: Number of TokenDist PDAs currently open (incremented by begin_token_dist,
decremented by close_token_dist). The owner-close requires this to be 0 so
a started token distribution can never be orphaned by a premature close.

fields.name: keeper_bounty
docs: Keeper bounty (lamports) reserved in the vault at init and paid to the
cranker that runs finalize_execution. Carved out of the SOL snapshot at
begin_execution so it never reduces beneficiary payouts. 0 = no bounty.
Taken from the account's existing padding — non-breaking (legacy vaults
deserialize this as 0).
